BiblicalUsage: Ithmah is named once, in 1 Chronicles 11:46. In 1 Chronicles 11:46 we read, "Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,".
TheologicalSignificance: Ithmah belonged to someone God knew, and I hold that every name in these lists did.
